text:
This looks like leftovers: a bowl with pink liquid (strawberry soup or yogurt remnants), a plate with sauce residue (soy sauce, wasabi, ginger) from sushi or similar, and a cup of dark soda.

"Everything on the plate" most likely means the food, so I counted the leftovers on the plate and in the bowl and left the drink out. The bowl holds about 40 g of strawberry or yogurt liquid at roughly 0.5 kcal/g, so about 20 kcal. The plate holds about 15 g of sauce residue at roughly 1 kcal/g, so about 15 kcal. The small cups hold soy sauce, ginger and wasabi, about 15 g in total for roughly 10 kcal. That makes about 45 kcal and 70 g.

If the soda were included it would add about 150 g and 60 kcal, but I excluded it.

{"kcal": 45, "mass_g": 70}
